items.topic: Read judo-ng from the JNG-6349_AddZetaValidatiob branch (DOX docs)
items.claim: Plan read 103 repos at origin/develop (or master).
items.fact: For the full judo-ng read, use branch origin/feature/JNG-6349_AddZetaValidatiob wherever it exists. That branch has DOX doctrine AGENTS.md files describing most source files. Repos without it fall back to develop.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-04T09:27:58Z, operator: 'all in the JNG-6349_AddZetaValidatiob branch where you can there are dox doctrine md file for most of the files!'

items.fact: On-branch repos: DOX AGENTS.md describes 2407/4123 source files (58%) (3452 files/23.5 MB described, 2731 files/13 MB not). AGENTS.md rows are per directory with table File|Purpose, plus per-file *.java.AGENTS.md. EMF src-gen generated code (344 files) is dropped. 103 repos, 483 MB worktrees.
Create one detached worktree per repo (git worktree add --detach -q <dst> <ref>) under target/judo-ng-read/wt/<repo with / replaced by __>, so reader subagents get clean checkouts at a fixed sha.

Operator asked: update the explore role to proxy/cc/claude-sonnet-5-5 for each subagent and validate with a test agent BEFORE starting the run. Test agent confirmed PI_MODEL=cc/claude-sonnet-5-5, PI_PROVIDER=proxy.

items.topic: Sonnet via proxy blocked by ToS reverse-engineering filter
items.claim: Reader subagents on sonnet-5-5 can read source.
items.fact: Subagent runs on proxy sonnet were rejected: 'blocked as it seems to violate Anthropic's Terms of Service restrictions on reverse engineering or duplicating model outputs'. Triggered by prompts asking to digest source code in bulk. Workaround: use haiku-5-5 for exploration, opus-5-5 for validation, and add context to the reader prompt that judo-ng is the operator's own company codebase (BlackBelt Technology) and the task is internal docs.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-04T09:39:46Z; operator: 'Sonnet seems to break it! use haiku 5-5 for exploration and opus 5-5 for validating... we don't do reverse engineering, it is our project and a private lib'

items.topic: Model roles: explore=haiku-5-5, validate=opus-5-5 via proxy
items.fact: Set roles explore=proxy/cc/claude-haiku-5-5 and validate=proxy/cc/claude-opus-5-5 (update_roles set_role). Subagents are invoked with model '@explore' / '@validate'. Verified via env PI_MODEL/PI_PROVIDER in test agents.

check_batch.py verifies each reader output: every file has an entry, cited repo@sha:path:line evidence exists, entry names symbols that appear in the file. It only checks line existence, not correctness, so an Opus validator samples entries/facts too (pilot: 0/88 facts wrong).

items.topic: Haiku reader may stall instead of writing unverified output
items.fact: Batch B098 (113 entries, 294 KB) failed: reader stopped, refused to write unverified entries and produced no output. Fix: smaller batches (<=35 items, ~110 KB) to fit Haiku's 200k context through the proxy; 660 then 550 batches after merging duplicate docs.
The class in dao-core is spelled `EmptyMapIntstanceCollector` (typo is real, referenced in dao-core collectors/AGENTS.md).

items.topic: DOX line counts off by one
items.claim: PayloadDaoProcessor.java.AGENTS.md says 340 lines; RdbmsDAOImpl.java.AGENTS.md says 933 lines.
items.fact: Actual: PayloadDaoProcessor 339 lines, RdbmsDAOImpl 932 lines.

InsertPayloadDaoProcessor: composition error is checkState with text 'Existing reference element cannot be set as a composition'. Update: 'Identifier is mandatory on reference association' from checkState (~line 359). RemoveReferencePayloadDaoProcessor isRequired branch is an empty placeholder. RefreshAuthorizer.authorize is empty. ReferenceValue oppositeIdentifiers defaults to ImmutableList.of(). DeleteStatement has only a constructor, no buildDeleteStatement.
feature/feature.xml declares Eclipse Public License v1.0.
That package does not exist; sources are under hu.blackbelt.judo.meta.esm.generator.engine.

items.topic: ESM validation docs use nonexistent @Guard shorthand and ctx.getAll
items.fact: Guard only declares method(), so the shorthand does not compile; ctx.getAll should be getAllInstances(...).

items.claim: AGENTS.md: a missing subpath always raises MojoExecutionException.
items.fact: True for getArtifact, but getResolvedTemplateDirectory on .jar/.zip calls extractArchive which returns an empty temp dir when nothing matches, so the existence check never fails; its IOException path builds the message from still-null fileFromArchive -> NPE instead of intended exception.

items.topic: ESM EVL DOX rows list nonexistent rules
items.claim: actorType.evl row lists a credential-validation rule; durationUnit.evl row lists nanosecond/month/year rules.
items.fact: Those rules do not exist in the files. Also operation.evl, dataMember.evl, oneWayRelationMember.evl, relationFeature.evl, transferObjectType.evl rows omit rules.
Omits public getIconNames() and public nested class IconEntry returned by searchIcons.

items.topic: Queue: 3 readers + 1 Opus verify per round
items.claim: Plan: Opus checks every batch from tier 1 and 1 in 5 of the rest.
items.fact: Operator rule: run 4 agents per round, always 3 next explore batches + 1 verify, taken from a queue (queue.py next/record/status, state in queue-state.json). Do not run a check for every batch. Failed/rejected readers retried twice then split. 550 batches (tier1 243), 184 rounds. If a repo's sampled batch fails, its batches get checked/re-read.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-04T09:53:23Z operator: 'Don't run check for each run checks once every 4 batch! ... always 4 but taken from a queue'

items.fact: Merge byte/near-identical docs (SKILL.md, INSTALL.md, README across modules) by normalised content hash so each is read once; 1299 docs deduped.

items.topic: DOX label strictness: agrees / agrees; omits / disagrees
items.claim: Reader labelled omissions as 'disagrees' (C002 verify fail 8/10, 0/27 facts wrong).
items.fact: Use 'agrees', 'agrees; omits: ...' for true-but-incomplete, and 'disagrees: ...' only when the row states something FALSE. Validator treats mislabels as minor. Readers must mark PARTIAL when they only grep a big file (C009 esm.ecore).

items.topic: Pitfall: dispatching ESM launcher/backend state facts
items.fact: JudoApplicationBackendLaunchStateTracker (designer-eclipse-runtime) has states enum (4 declared, ERROR never emitted), health polling thread; JudoProjectGeneratorLauncher.getUpdaterVersion reads key judo-version-updater-maven-plugin-version from judo-version.properties.
